lines: As of Q3 2025: $32.5B total assets (record), $27.5B deposits (record), approximately 1,818 employees — 90% of whom joined since the 2021 transformation began. Workday confirmed as HR and ATS platform (texascapitalbank.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com). TCB employs a talent-first strategy: 50% of commercial and industrial clients are now covered by industry-specialized bankers, up from near-zero in 2021.

TREND CLASSIFICATION: ACCELERATING — 73 basis points ROAA improvement from FY2021 to Q3 2025; ROATCE from 2.0% to 12.0% (10pp improvement); fee income +84% since Q3 2021; PPNR +30% YoY Q3 2025 (all-time record $150M). Revenue growth forecast: +20% p.a. average next two years vs. 7.2% banking industry benchmark.

CAGR Estimates: Fee Income CAGR FY2021–FY2025: ~+40%; Tangible Book Value per share CAGR: ~+8% (FY2024 record, then Q3 2025 record $73.02/share). Asset CAGR FY2021–Q3 2025: ~+2% — reflecting deliberate capital rebalancing (mortgage correspondent exit, BankDirect sale) followed by organic growth acceleration.

TREND CLASSIFICATION: ACCELERATING. TCB's financial trajectory from FY2021 (transformation start) to Q3 2025 (transformation declared complete) shows a sustained multi-year recovery and acceleration. Key performance targets set at the September 2021 strategic update have been met or exceeded. Q3 2025 results beat analyst estimates by >20% ($2.18 EPS vs $1.81 estimated).

Key Financial Signals for Salesforce Account Executive: (1) Fee income 84%+ growth since Q3 2021 — TCB has successfully transformed from a spread-dependent bank to a fee-generating financial services firm. (2) ROATCE target >12.5% — Q3 2025 hit 12.0%, signaling capital available for platform investment. (3) Revenue forecast +20% p.a. next 2 years vs. 7.2% industry — aggressive product and technology investment cycle ahead. (4) CET1 12.14% and TCE/TA 10.25% (#1 capitalization vs. peer group) — balance sheet strength supports technology investment without capital constraints. (5) Treasury Product Fees +23% YoY for 4th consecutive quarter — each new treasury API product is a MuleSoft use case.
